name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A row of slides that is scrolled sideways one at a time (or a few at a time), with previous and next buttons, dots or a count, keys, and an optional autoplay that always has a pause button.

meta.when: A handful of pictures or cards of equal weight where one (or a few) is enough at a time: the photos of a place, featured items, quotes. It is the browser's own scrolling with CSS scroll snap, so a swipe, a trackpad and momentum work as they do everywhere, right-to-left pages mirror by themselves and nothing moves under reduced motion; no carousel package is used (Embla, MIT, moves slides with transforms on its own engine, which this does not need). Set how many slides show with a basis on the slides (`className="basis-1/2 md:basis-1/3"`). Do not hide content a person must read in a carousel, and do not autoplay anything with text to read. For looking at pictures large use gallery with lightbox; for scenes of a clip use scene-strip; for thousands of items use virtual-list.
